title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. The notes study the 'structure at infinity' of M_{g,ν} via its boundary stratification. Strata M_G are indexed by stable dual graphs G. ΠM_G is the (stacky) fundamental groupoid of a stratum. For a generalization G→G' (contraction of edges), ΠM_{G,G'} is the groupoid of a tubular neighbourhood of M_G inside the closure of M_{G'}. ΠM*_{G,G'} is the groupoid of the deleted neighbourhood, meaning that neighbourhood intersected with the open stratum M_{G'}. The previous page showed that the composition squares of these groupoids are 2-cartesian.

This page. Grothendieck takes the coarsest generalization G→G', where G' is the one-vertex graph of the discrete modular datum (g,ν). That is, G' is the open part M_{g,ν}. He defines (113) S_AΠM_G := ΠM*_{G,G'}. This is the fundamental groupoid of the punctured tubular neighbourhood of M_G in M_{g,ν}. It is an extension of ΠM_{G,G'} (essentially ΠM_G) by Z^{A(G)}, where A(G) is the set of edges. Each edge contributes the loop around the corresponding branch of the normal-crossing boundary divisor, i.e. the Dehn twist about the corresponding vanishing cycle.

The group Γ_G = Aut G acts on M_G, on ΠM_G, and on S_AΠM_G through its action on M*_{G,G'}, compatibly with the canonical map (114). Hence for any subgroup Γ' ⊂ Γ_G one gets an extension of 'groupoids with operators' (115):
(S_AΠM_G, Γ') → (ΠM_G, Γ'), also written S_AΠ(M_G,Γ') → Π(M_G,Γ').
Its 'kernel' is the local system Z^{A(G)} on (ΠM_G,Γ'), twisted by the permutation action of Γ' on edges.

If C ⊂ A(G) is Γ'-stable, the projection (116) Z^{A(G)} → Z^C is a map of local systems. Pushing out along it (next page) gives a quotient extension S_CΠM_G by Z^C. This is meant to match the deleted neighbourhood of M_G in M_{G/C}. The next page then builds functoriality maps S_AΠM_G → S_{A'}ΠM_{G'} for quotients G' = G/C.

In mapping-class-group language: S_AΠM_G at a base point is the stabilizer of a multicurve σ (with |σ| = |A(G)|). It is an extension of the product of mapping class groups of the pieces (extended by graph automorphisms) by the free abelian group of Dehn twists along σ, twisted by the permutation action on the components of σ.
errors: No mathematical error is visible. Two minor imprecisions:

The text calls S_AΠM_G an extension of ΠM_{G,G'}, but (114) and (115) use ΠM_G as the base. These agree only after identifying the tubular-neighbourhood groupoid with ΠM_G (or the stacky version with Γ_G). Grothendieck himself flags 'expliciter un peu...'.

The Z^{A(G)} kernel is central only for the 'pure' part. Once Γ' acts, it is a twisted (non-central) local system, as he correctly notes. Edge-flip automorphisms of loops (a self-node with branches exchanged) act trivially on the twist, a subtlety not discussed here.

ideas.what: Fundamental groupoid of the deleted tubular neighbourhood of a boundary stratum M_G in M_{g,ν}, as an extension of ΠM_G by Z^{edges}
ideas.modern_name: Stabilizer of a multicurve in the mapping class group; Dehn-twist extension; 'inertia/decomposition' structure at the boundary of M̄_{g,n}
ideas.usually_credited_to: Harvey (1979, boundary structure and curve complex), Birman–Lubotzky–McCarthy (1983), Ivanov; arithmetic versions: Ihara–Nakamura, Nakamura, Hatcher–Lochak–Schneps
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme alludes to the boundary structure of the Teichmüller tower but gives no such formalism

ideas.what: Twisting the Z^{A(G)} kernel by the Aut G action on edges; extensions of groupoids with operators (ΠM_G, Γ')
ideas.modern_name: Equivariant / stacky fundamental groupoid of strata; twisted local system of Dehn twists
ideas.usually_credited_to: standard (orbifold fundamental groups of boundary strata)

ideas.what: Push-out along Z^{A} → Z^C for a Γ'-stable set of edges C, giving intermediate extensions S_CΠM_G
ideas.modern_name: Groupoid of the deleted neighbourhood of M_G in an intermediate stratum M_{G/C}; partial degenerations
ideas.usually_credited_to: standard in the treatment of the Teichmüller tower / boundary groupoids

missed.claim: This is a systematic groupoid-with-operators formalism for the boundary of M_{g,ν}: deleted neighbourhoods, edge-twisted Dehn-twist local systems, and functorial push-outs indexed by stable edge sets. It anticipates the later 'Teichmüller tower / boundary groupoid' formalism, but adds no new theorem beyond what is now standard.
missed.quote: dont le "noyau" est le système local Z^{A(G)} sur (ΠM_G, Γ'), tordu grâce à l'action de Γ' sur A(G)
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Mainly of historical interest: it documents Grothendieck's own approach to the boundary structure underlying the Grothendieck–Teichmüller programme.

deep.surprise_reason: The content is the now-standard description of multicurve stabilizers as Dehn-twist extensions, phrased with stacky groupoids. The care about the twisted action and the C-quotients is nice but routine for specialists.
transcription_corrections: Margin note reads roughly 'ici A désigne l'ens. des arêtes de G.'; the word 'arêtes' is fairly clear.
Top right contains a heavily crossed-out 'ΠM_{G,G'} =' fragment.
In (114) the target is '(ΠM_G, Γ_G)' with the subscript partly struck over.
